title: Adjoining p-th roots of p-independent elements gives degree p^n
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$ and let $a_1,\dots,a_n\in k$ be elements such that $\mathrm da_1,\dots,\mathrm da_n$ are linearly independent over $k$ in the module of K\"ahler differentials $\Omega_{k/\mathbf F_p}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Let $\bar k$ be an algebraic closure of $k$ and $a_i^{1/p}\in\bar k$ the (unique) $p$-th roots. Then the subfield $k(a_1^{1/p},\dots,a_n^{1/p})\subseteq\bar k$ has degree $p^n$ over $k$.
